title: C++: Polymorphism
description: Demonstrate runtime polymorphism with virtual functions and a Shape hierarchy.

steps.title: Shape Area Polymorphism
steps.description: Define an abstract Shape class with virtual double area() = 0. Derive Circle(double r, area = pi*r*r) and Rectangle(double w, double h, area = w*h). Store both in vector<Shape*> and print areas.
hints: virtual double area() const = 0; // pure virtual
Circle(double r) : r(r) {} double area() override { return 3.14159 * r * r; }

verification.failureMessage: Print areas of Circle(3) and Rectangle(4,5)
